context: The defense has blitzed on the last three plays.

options.reason: A blitzing defense runs itself right past a screen. Let the rushers through, toss it to the back, and he has blockers and open grass.
A run can punish a blitz too, but the screen uses the defense's own speed against it.
Play action needs a long drop and a lot of time. Against a blitz the quarterback gets hit before the post route is open.
